name: pixelagents
short: Vendor and build the Pixel Agents webview for floorplan to serve
description: Clones and builds the pinned pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents webview commit into Red's per-cog data directory, so floorplan (and any other dependent cog) can serve the result without running its own build. Owns the vendor pin and the build pipeline only -- no dashboard, presence mirroring, or WebSocket protocol; see floorplan for those.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Requires corridor (auto-loaded). Bot owner only: `[p]pixelagents webview commit` to see the pinned commit, `[p]pixelagents webview rebuild` to force a rebuild. floorplan depends on this cog to serve the built webview.
author: Pixel Agents HQ Contributors
